stage: proposed-circuit independent review; final CAD not reviewed
scope: D1 replacement by Q11/D37/R85; preserve F1, D36, U12, all downstream rail settings and Qwiic; valve-control choice
verdict: No confirmed DC topology blocker. Saved implementation, routing, and bench transients remain unverified.

device_checks.Q11_pinout: Visual manufacturer top view, rotated tab upward: lower leads G/D/S left-to-right; tab drain. Matches pins 1/2/3 G/D/S.
device_checks.Q11_voltage_ratings: 60 V drain-source and ±20 V gate-source; positive 12 V normal / cold reversed 12 V have static margin.
device_checks.Q11_thermal_limit: 7 A and 60 °C/W use a 2 oz, one-inch-square copper test board. Do not transfer to actual layout. Resistance rises with temperature.
device_checks.D37_voltage: 10 V nominal, 9.4–10.6 V specified at 5 mA. Ten-kilohm pull-down gives about 0.2 mA assuming a 10 V clamp from a 12 V source; exact clamp value is not guaranteed at this current.
device_checks.D37_polarity: Band/cathode to source/VIN_RAW; anode to gate.
device_checks.gate_drive_basis: At 25 °C, zener leakage maximum 0.2 µA at 7 V is far below resistor current at that operating point, supporting VSG above 7 V at a normal 12 V input; do not claim a guaranteed 10 V drive across temperature.

loss_estimate.limit: Device test bound at 25 °C, not a hot-layout guarantee.

state_reasoning.assessment: Body diode from incoming drain toward protected source starts charging VIN_RAW; gate pulled toward GND develops negative VGS and turns on. U12 downstream UVLO and controlled slew reduce later startup loading. Need saved layout and startup measurement.
Source/gate initially near GND, reverse-biased body diode blocks incoming negative drain. Gate-source zener is oriented correctly.

A single enhanced P-MOS can conduct backward until it turns off. U12 blocks downstream output-to-input current, but local VIN_RAW capacitor discharge and possible D36 forward-current transients depend on source and wiring. This is not an ideal-diode guarantee or qualified live-reversal protection.

remaining_validation: Final exported netlist and native PCB pin mapping including duplicate drain tab
SOT223 pad sizes and orientation against manufacturer land pattern; zener polarity and short source-gate loop
Native saved and analyzed-refill DRC, ERC, exact retained pin/geometry comparison, unchanged design-rule severity/exclusions
Bench voltage drop and temperature at intended load/ambient; scope startup/input removal and any required reversed-input transient

valve_decision.basis: Exact FA0520E specification defines two-position three-way operation at 5–6 V and an on/off endurance test. It supplies no qualified PWM hold-current duty or proportional characteristic. Introducing PWM would require a new electrical/mechanical qualification. Existing valve voltage-tolerance risk is separately accepted for the prototype and is not resolved by PWM.

prior_accepted_risks: U5 reset timing and valve rail upper-tolerance margin remain user-accepted prototype risks; neither is changed by this proposal.
